tools.name: mightynetworks_get_me
tools.description: Return the account that owns this API key: its id, name and roles. Good first call to check that the key works.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_network
tools.description: Return the network's title, slug, description, URL, creation time and billing plan name.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_spaces
tools.description: List the network's spaces (groups or channels) with title, URL, member count and archived flag. Page with the returned endCursor.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_space
tools.description: Return one space by its id or URL slug: title, URL, member count, archived flag and creation time.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_space_posts
tools.description: List the posts in one space, newest first, with title, plain-text body, author and comment count.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_post
tools.description: Return one post by its id or URL slug, with its plain-text body, author, space, status and comment count.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one post with plain-text body, author, thread depth and reply count. Set root_only to skip replies.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_members
tools.description: List network members with name, join date, member type, role and last activity. Emails are not returned. Filter by role or member type. Page with the returned endCursor.

tools.name: mightynetworks_get_member
tools.description: Return one member by id: name, location, join date, member type, roles and follower counts. Emails are not returned.

tools.name: mightynetworks_list_events
tools.description: List upcoming or past event occurrences with title, start and end times, URL and RSVP counts. Optionally limit to one space.

tools.name: mightynetworks_create_post
tools.description: Create a post in a space as the host. Default status is DRAFT (not visible to members). POSTED publishes it to the space right away. notify false (default) sends no member notification.

tools.name: mightynetworks_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a post as the host. Pass reply_to_id to reply inside a thread.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: mightynetworks_get_network, mightynetworks_list_spaces, mightynetworks_get_space, mightynetworks_list_space_posts, mightynetworks_get_post, mightynetworks_list_comments, mightynetworks_list_members, mightynetworks_get_member, mightynetworks_list_events · Private data: mightynetworks_get_me · Public sink: mightynetworks_get_post, mightynetworks_list_comments, mightynetworks_create_post, mightynetworks_create_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: mightynetworks_get_network, mightynetworks_list_spaces, mightynetworks_get_space, mightynetworks_list_space_posts, mightynetworks_get_post, mightynetworks_list_comments, mightynetworks_list_members, mightynetworks_get_member, mightynetworks_list_events · Private data: mightynetworks_get_me · Public sink: mightynetworks_get_post, mightynetworks_list_comments, mightynetworks_create_post, mightynetworks_create_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
